# Ways to pay your bill

You can pay your bill in several ways. Choose the one that suits you best.

## Direct debit

Set up direct debit from a bank account or credit card and your bill is paid automatically on
the due date. You can set it up in your online account or by calling customer service.

## Online account and app

Log in to your online account or the app to pay by credit or debit card at any time.

## BPAY

Use the biller code and reference number printed on your bill to pay through your bank's
online banking.

## Paying in person

You can pay at any post office using the barcode on your bill.

## Paying in instalments

If you would rather pay smaller amounts more often, you can set up a payment plan to pay
weekly, fortnightly or monthly. See "Help if you're struggling to pay" if you are having
trouble paying.
